_doc: NPC helpers. One waits at each starting location (in order) and will follow a solo player until they team up with a real one.

companions.name: Dolores
companions.blurb: A former contestant who now mops the Break Room and resents it.
companions.join: Fine. But I walk behind you, and if you die I keep your shoes.
companions.leave: You have real friends now. Try not to get them killed. I'll be mopping.

companions.name: Gus
companions.blurb: Lost Property clerk. Has been looking for his own stapler since last season.
companions.join: I'll come. Somebody has to carry the paperwork.
companions.leave: Two's company, three's an insurance problem. Good luck out there.

companions.name: Vex
companions.blurb: Boiler technician. Will not say what the boiler is for.
companions.join: I hit things with a wrench. That's the whole offer.
companions.leave: You found your people. I'm going back to the boiler. Don't ask about the boiler.
